data.mechanism: Cytosolic arginine binds CASTOR1 and breaks its grip on GATOR2 - the same trick as leucine/Sestrin2, but for a different amino acid.
data.mechanism_beginner: Arginine sticks to CASTOR1 the same way leucine sticks to Sestrin2 – the same trick, for a different amino acid.
data.boundary: Human cells and structural work (CHA2016, SAX2016, VAL2025, JAN2025). The 2025 structures show how arginine binding changes CASTOR1 so that it lets go of GATOR2. Shows how arginine is sensed in cells and in purified proteins. Whether this sensor matters for arginine supply in a whole animal or a person is not tested here.
